summary.text: Beth Richards is a Democratic state representative from Merrimack District 17 who has served since December 7, 2022, and is seeking re-election on November 3, 2026, after advancing from the September 8, 2026 primary.

paragraphs.text: Richards earned a B.A. in art history from the University of Pennsylvania in 1993, according to Ballotpedia.

Her career experience includes owning Local Baskit and working as principal of Organized Communications, development and marketing director of the Safe Routes to School National Partnership, and senior consultant with M+R Strategic Services.
She also served as state vice president for development of the American Cancer Society.
Ballotpedia lists Richards on the Environment and Agriculture Committee in 2017 and 2019-2020, and on the Legislative Administration Committee in 2021-2022 and 2023-2024.
